name: row-probe

tests.filter: chat-capital-effort0, 40 rows, 48 passes, every op per row
chat-sky-effort0.9, 49 rows, 48 passes, every op per row
last op alone, fp16 and exact unembed, chat-capital-effort0 + chat-sky-effort0.9 (89 rows)
last op alone, raw-counting + raw-long-window (1,176 rows)
gap error at the oracle's top-2 against the engine fixture and the floor, 4 prompts, 1,265 rows

commands: nice -n 19 teacher_force.py --pack <pack> --engine <fixgate dump>/prefill0000{0,2}.safetensors --out report.json --per-row --workers 8 --threads 2   (node-1, two runs in parallel, 54 and 56 minutes wall)
notes: The three argmax differences (row 5 of both chat prompts, which is one position with one prefix, and row 23 of the sky prompt) are not an op and not the unembed: the unembed matches the engine's own logits to 1e-6 relative and moves the gap at the oracle's top-2 by at most 0.002; every op at those rows is inside the spread of the other rows (worst ratio to the median of the other rows 5.9 at rows 5 and 23 (attn_in, 5.8 attention core), against 17.9 for the worst row anywhere); the engine's gap error at them (-0.30, -0.26) lies at the 78th to 85th percentile of the chat prompts (rows with oracle margin below 3)' |gap error| and exceeds the oracle margins (0.167, 0.22). Teacher forcing hides accumulation over 48 passes, so the end-to-end divergence at a row is not decomposed per op here.
